title: Enchanted Wilds

mechanics.d: Single-use boosts that appear in the rightmost slot of every other shop. You can buy one per round, and after stage 5 every other Wisp is a Combat Wisp. They range from combat power to gold, XP, items, champions and risky deals. Wisps are an updated take on Set 12's Charms.
A 5-cost who can represent one of nine Origins: Blackthorn, Blossom, Coven, Elderwood, Fae, Inferno, Lunar, Primal or Solar. Her chosen trait counts twice.
Riftbeast is the largest trait with 10 champions. The Elder Dragon takes two team slots and adds 2 to your Riftbeast count.
Field 3 Solar and 3 Lunar champions to unlock a hidden trait that executes the lowest-Health enemy on a timer.
Set 17 replaced the Carousel with the Realm of the Gods. Enchanted Wilds brings the classic Carousel back.
Units no longer pick a new target when they come out of crowd control (patch 18.1).

patches.n: Launch patch: Wisps, the Carousel's return, no retargeting after crowd control.
First main patch, mostly buffs: cheaper Combat Wisps, less XP for levels 8–10 (partly reverted Sep 14), buffs to Blackthorn, Coven, Fae, Hunter and Inferno; Rapidfire and Solar toned down.
Focused patch: Coven buffed; Defender, Hunter, Inferno and Invoker nerfed; Blossom's Wisp values and several Wisps retuned.

traits.name: Adaptor
traits.desc: Abilities change depending on whether the unit's Attack Damage or Ability Power is higher, and the trait boosts whichever is higher.

traits.name: Blackthorn
traits.desc: The ally on the Blackthorn hex is sacrificed before combat. Your team gains Health, and Blackthorn units gain extra stats based on the sacrificed unit's role, star level and cost.

traits.name: Blossom
traits.desc: Wisps are empowered after combat and Blossom units gain AD, AP and max Health. Higher tiers upgrade Wisps, stock one in every shop, pay gold when you buy one, allow two buys per round, then overflow them with power.

traits.name: Brawler
traits.desc: Your team gains max Health, and Brawlers gain more.

traits.name: Coven
traits.desc: High risk, high reward. Earn Essence from kills and from losing combats, then cash it in for rewards or keep stacking for bigger ones.

traits.name: Defender
traits.desc: Your team gains Armor and Magic Resist, and Defenders gain more.

traits.name: Elderwood
traits.desc: Unlock placeable plants: Stonebark Trees, a Lifebloom and finally the Deepwood Protector. At the top two tiers the plants star up.

traits.name: Executioner
traits.desc: Gain Precision and Critical Strike Chance. From 3, enemies also bleed true damage, and 4 raises the bleed.

traits.name: Fae
traits.desc: Your team's damage, healing and shielding attract Pixies that buff Fae units. At 4, Golden Pixies appear and grant gold.

traits.name: Flora Fatalis
traits.desc: Harvest enemies on takedown for Mana. At 2, each harvest also heals your lowest-Health ally.

traits.name: Hunter
traits.desc: Hunters gain Attack Damage, plus Damage Amp while they stay on the same target.

traits.name: Inferno
traits.desc: Inferno damage Burns and Wounds. From 3, after combat a shop slot without an Inferno champion ignites and rolls a higher-cost champion.

traits.name: Invoker
traits.desc: Your team gains Mana Regen, and Invokers gain more.

traits.name: Juggernaut
traits.desc: Your team gains Durability, and Juggernauts gain more.

traits.name: Lunar
traits.desc: Lunar units and the allies next to them gain Attack Speed and Ability Power, with Lunar units gaining more.

traits.name: Primal
traits.desc: Choose one of four Primal Blessings at 2, and a second at 4.

traits.name: Rapidfire
traits.desc: Your team gains Attack Speed. Rapidfire units gain more on every attack, up to a stack cap.

traits.name: Ravager
traits.desc: Gain Omnivamp and bonus damage, doubled against low-Health enemies.

traits.name: Riftbeast
traits.desc: At 3, use the Alpha Mark to give one Riftbeast a unique buff. At 5, every few combats your next shop is overrun with Riftbeasts. At 7, Riftbeasts grow at combat start and over time. At 10, +2 max team size.

traits.name: Rival
traits.desc: Rivals collect takedowns, with extra credit for beating the other Rival. At 1 only one can be fielded; at 2 both play together and their abilities buff each other.

traits.name: Solar
traits.desc: Your team gains a max Health shield and bonus magic damage. Each unique 3-star champion adds more, and with enough of them part of the damage turns true and a 3-star ascends to 4-star mid-combat.

traits.name: Spellweaver
traits.desc: Your team gains Ability Power, Spellweavers gain more, plus extra AP each time one casts.

traits.name: Sprykin
traits.desc: Gain the Big Furry Friend and drop a Sprykin on it to choose its Rider. Higher tiers raise the bonuses and share the Friend's ability with your Sprykin.

traits.name: Summoner
traits.desc: Summoners empower their summons, each in its own way. At 3 every effect improves.

traits.name: Vanguard
traits.desc: At combat start and when dropping below half Health, Vanguards gain a max Health shield. At 6 they also gain Durability while shielded.

traits.name: Apex Predator
traits.desc: The Elder Dragon takes two team slots and adds 2 to your Riftbeast count.

traits.name: Attuned
traits.desc: Your strongest Alune moves to a new moon phase after each cast. At or below half moon your team gains Durability; above it, Damage Amp.

traits.name: Avatar
traits.desc: An Avatar on your bench or board turns other Avatars in your shop into its own trait, and its chosen trait counts twice.

traits.name: Bounty Seeker
traits.desc: Choose a bounty. Your strongest Draven progresses it to earn a reward (champions, gold, items, rerolls or XP), then you pick another.

traits.name: Caustic
traits.desc: Caustic damage Shreds and Sunders enemies, lowering their Magic Resist and Armor for a few seconds.

traits.name: Emerald Aspect
traits.desc: Drag an ally onto your strongest Taric to pair them. The ally gains bonuses from Taric's ability.

traits.name: Greenfather
traits.desc: Ivern gains seeds on cast and every combat, and spends them to grow a hex on your board that buffs its occupant.

traits.name: Monolith
traits.desc: Malphite gains Armor and Magic Resist for each enemy targeting him.

traits.name: Old Growth
traits.desc: When an enemy dies near Maokai he gains permanent max Health.

traits.name: Thornmaiden
traits.desc: Your team gains Durability, more while enough Zyra plants are alive.

traits.name: Eclipse
traits.desc: Hidden trait. Activates with 3 Solar and 3 Lunar champions on the board. After a set time in combat it kills the lowest-Health enemy, then repeats on a timer.

source: Compiled from public Set 18 guides and Riot's patch notes (patch 18.3, Sept 2026). Ability values are left out because they change nearly every patch. Not affiliated with Riot Games.
